Our Amy Winter Thermal Phone Pocket Tech legging has also been designed with a gusset. This triangular panel of fabric sewn into the crotch (gusset) prevents the leggings from 'riding up' (no camel toe) and provides more flexibility and freedom of movement. The thermal lining also gives a more compressive feel when worn. If you would prefer a more relaxed fit for all day wear we suggest you go up a size. If you prefer a more snug and firm fit, we suggest your usual size. PLEASE NOTE: Due to the nature of brushed fleece, these leggings can be prone to pilling so we recommend washing yours inside out in our Active Washbag on a delicate cycle to extend it's life.
